Cracker Barrel Menu with Prices Daily Specials

When you think about warm homestyle meals, cozy old country store vibes, and hearty daily specials, Cracker Barrel always tops the list. Whether you’re planning to order online for takeout and fast delivery or dine in at your neighborhood Cracker Barrel, this comprehensive guide will walk you through everything on the Cracker Barrel menu with prices, from breakfast to dinner. Here, you’ll find detailed sections on classic comfort food favorites, signature sides like fried apples, and new must-try items like the campfire menu.

What Makes Cracker Barrel a Homestyle Favorite?

Cracker Barrel has always been more than just a restaurant — it’s a place where comfort food classics come alive, where buttery biscuits are hand-rolled daily, and where every meal feels like home. Their old country store attached to each location lets guests take a piece of the country home, while the daily specials keep regulars coming back for fresh, seasonal homestyle meals. Curious about the roots of comfort food? This Smithsonian article on American comfort food is a great read.

View Cracker Barrel Menu and Order Online for Takeout

For ultimate convenience, you can easily view Cracker Barrel offerings and order online for takeout. Whether you crave a homestyle breakfast with thick-sliced bacon or a hearty dinner with country fried steak, you can get your favorites online for takeout and fast delivery.

Cracker Barrel Breakfast Menu with Prices

Below is a breakdown of popular breakfast items you can find on the Cracker Barrel menu with prices.

Breakfast Item Description Price
Old Timer’s Breakfast Two farm fresh eggs, grits, fried apples or hashbrown casserole, plus thick-sliced bacon or smoked sausage. Served with hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $9.99
Sunrise Sampler Two eggs, grits, fried apples, hashbrown casserole, thick-sliced bacon, smoked sausage, country ham, plus buttermilk biscuit or corn muffin. $10.99
Grandma’s Sampler Three mini pancakes filled with fruit, two eggs, plus a half order of thick-sliced bacon or smoked sausage, served with a side of fried apples or hashbrown casserole. $11.49
Country Fried Steak & Eggs Country fried steak topped with sawmill gravy, two farm fresh eggs, choice of fried apples or hashbrown casserole, plus two hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $12.99
French Toast Breakfast Griddled slices of our French toast topped with butter and served with two eggs plus choice of thick-sliced bacon or smoked sausage. $9.49

Cracker Barrel Lunch Specials

Each weekday brings a fresh daily special, giving you a reason to drop by or order online for a warm homestyle meal.

Day Special Description Price
Monday Baked Chicken & Dressing Simmered right in our kitchen and served with choice of two country sides and hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $11.29
Tuesday Meatloaf & Mashed Potatoes Generous portion topped with sawmill gravy, choice of fried apples or hashbrown casserole. $10.99
Wednesday Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Served with choice of two country sides and hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $11.99
Thursday Turkey n’ Dressing Slow-roasted turkey with gravy, plus two country sides and buttermilk biscuits. $12.49
Friday Fish Fry Four cod fillets hand-dipped in our special buttermilk batter, fried crispy, served with tartar sauce plus three hushpuppies and choice of two sides. $13.99
Saturday Country Fried Pork Chops Two chops topped with sawmill gravy, served with two country sides and biscuits. $12.79
Sunday Sunday Homestyle Chicken Generous portion of our Sunday Homestyle Chicken with three country sides and hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $13.49

Dinner Features on the Cracker Barrel Menu

When dinner rolls around, the Cracker Barrel menu with prices offers hearty portions that feel like Sunday supper every day of the week. For tips on making classic Southern suppers, here’s Southern Living’s guide to Southern dinner favorites.

Dinner Entrée Description Price
Country Fried Steak Topped with sawmill gravy, served with a side plus two hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits. $12.99
10 oz New York Strip Steak New York Strip Steak topped with garlic butter, choice of two country sides, plus buttermilk biscuits or corn muffins. $17.99
Fried Shrimp Platter A generous portion of fried shrimp with cocktail sauce plus three hushpuppies, served with two country sides. $14.49
Chicken n’ Dumplins Simmered in homestyle broth, served with choice of two country sides and buttermilk biscuits. $11.49
Campfire Chicken Part of the campfire menu, includes juicy grilled chicken with veggies, plus two sides and buttermilk biscuits. $12.79

Cracker Barrel Sides and Add-Ons

Every meal feels complete with signature sides. Cracker Barrel menu sides are as comforting as the mains.

  • Hashbrown Casserole Fried into Crispy Bite-Sized Tots

  • Fried Apples

  • Country Green Beans

  • Buttery Corn

  • Macaroni n’ Cheese

  • Freshly Brewed Iced Tea

  • Buttermilk Biscuit or Corn Muffin

How to Order Online and Enjoy Takeout Fast

Ordering online for takeout is simple. Just view Cracker Barrel menu, select your favorites, and pick up your homestyle meal hot and ready. They also offer fast curbside pickup for families on the go. If you’re curious about how takeout is transforming dining, see this breakdown of food delivery trends from Forbes.

Cracker Barrel’s Neighborhood Vibe and Old Country Store

Every neighborhood Cracker Barrel doubles as an old country store stocked with nostalgic gifts, candy, and signature sauces. After your meal, grab your freshly brewed iced tea, browse for goodies, and enjoy that warm, welcoming country feel.

More Favorites: Campfire Menu and Seasonal Features

The campfire menu is a seasonal treat inspired by campfire cooking. Options like tender pot roast, foil-pack veggies, and savory sides make it a must-try.

Best Comfort Food for Breakfast to Dinner

From country fried steak to thick-sliced bacon, fried apples, and hand-dipped shrimp, the Cracker Barrel menu has something for everyone. Whether you want breakfast side plus country fried steak, or three mini pancakes filled with chocolate chips, the menu spans sweet to savory — always served with a smile.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I Order the Full Cracker Barrel Menu Online?

Yes, you can order online for takeout and fast delivery. Everything — from breakfast sides plus sirloin steak to a 10 oz New York Strip Steak topped with garlic butter — is available to enjoy at home.

Does Cracker Barrel Offer Catering?

Cracker Barrel offers generous portions perfect for gatherings. Popular picks include the Sunday Homestyle Chicken, country fried steak, and sides like fried apples and hashbrown casserole.

Seasonal Daily Specials to Look Out For

The daily specials change with the seasons, so whether it’s summer’s campfire menu or winter’s warm pot roasts, there’s always something new. Keep an eye on the menu and order online page to see what’s fresh.

Signature Comforts: Hand-Rolled Buttermilk Biscuits

A meal at Cracker Barrel isn’t complete without their hand-rolled buttermilk biscuits or corn muffins — fluffy, buttery, and baked fresh. These biscuits come with nearly every dish, from fried shrimp to fried sunday homestyle chicken.

Love a good deal on food and drinks? Don’t miss the BJ’s Daily Specials, Deals & Happy Hours – full menu & Pizookie deals for all the scoop on their signature Pizookie® desserts, craft brews, and unbeatable combo offers.

Top Cracker Barrel Combos

  • Breakfast to Dinner Combo: Two eggs plus choice of thick-sliced bacon, plus a side of fried apples or hashbrown casserole.

  • New York Strip Steak Combo: 10 oz steak with garlic butter, choice of fried apples, two country sides, and biscuits.

  • Seafood Lover’s Platter: Fried cod fillets, cocktail sauce, hushpuppies, and a side of hashbrown casserole fried into crispy bite-sized tots.

Comfort Drinks: Signature Tea to Make It Complete

Pair your meal with freshly brewed iced tea or signature lemonade to round off that homestyle feeling.

Visit Your Neighborhood Cracker Barrel Today

Ready for a hearty meal? Stop by your neighborhood Cracker Barrel, or order online for takeout. From breakfast to dinner, their menu satisfies every craving — with that comforting country touch.

Final Thoughts: Why Cracker Barrel is America’s Favorite Comfort Food Spot

When you choose Cracker Barrel, you’re choosing more than a meal. You’re choosing homestyle, hand-prepared dishes, a warm country welcome, and the comfort of knowing there’s always something delicious on the daily specials board. Want to learn more about the history of this beloved chain? Read Cracker Barrel’s story on their official site.

So, whether you want to view Cracker Barrel, relax in their old country store, or simply order online for takeout and fast, you’ll always feel at home.

Check back often for new daily specials, seasonal treats like the campfire menu, and classic comfort foods served with fluffy buttermilk biscuits or corn muffins. With generous portions, friendly service, and great prices, Cracker Barrel is ready to welcome you, your family, and your appetite.

Ready to dig in?
Order online or visit your local neighborhood Cracker Barrel today for the best comfort food, warm hospitality, and a taste of country living — one buttery biscuit at a time
